rows.job_description:
Background

We are looking for a Staff Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications that delivery business value across the organization. This role is focused on building AI applications and services at scale. You will be responsible for building robust, secure, and highly scalable systems that integrate with leading cloud-based AI services.

As a senior individual contributor, you will bring deep technical expertise, drive high-quality engineering practices, and serve as a mentor for junior to mid-level engineers. You will work closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to translate business problems into production-grade AI applications and services.

Key Responsibilities

Application and Solution Engineering

Design, build, and ship production-grade Generative and Agentic AI applications and services for internal and external users
Develop high-quality backend services in Python, with strong software engineering rigor around testing, performance, and maintainability
Champion reusability and abstraction in everything you build by designing and building modular, well-abstracted components and libraries
Build multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK and Google ADK
Integrate with leading LLM and foundation model APIs, including Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking
Build clean, well-tested RESTful and/or gRPC APIs with a strong focus on reliability, security, and performance
Implement observability, tracing, evaluation, guardrails for Generative and Agentic AI applications
Deploy and operate services on major cloud providers (e.g., GCP, AWS, and Azure) leveraging managed services
Contribute to platform architecture decisions and engineering best practices
Take applications from prototype through production deployment, hardening, and ongoing operation

Mentorship and Team Development

Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and pair programming
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
Participate in technical design reviews and contribute to the professional growth of team members

Required Qualifications

10-15 years of professional software engineering experience with at least 3-5 years of experience building AI/ML software products
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master’s degree preferred)
Strong proficiency in Python, with deep software engineering fundamentals (abstraction, modularity, system design, testing, performance)
Hands-on experience building and shipping Generative and Agentic AI applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, and/or agentic workflows
Practical experience integrating cloud-hosted LLM APIs such as Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and/or AWS Bedrock
Experience with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Open Search, AlloyDB)
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Azure
Strong understanding of API design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture
Proven track record of taking systems from design through production deployment and operation

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Knowledge of Generative AI Risk Management frameworks (NIST RFM)
Experience supporting developer platforms or internal tooling
Experience writing design documents or helping define engineering standards

POSITION SUMMARY 

 

In this role, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and implementing AI-driven tooling and automation to transform and enhance the operations of a critical cloud-based platform. Your primary responsibility will be to identify operational challenges and build intelligent solutions that automate repetitive tasks, accelerate incident detection and resolution, improve observability, and enable more proactive and predictive operations. 

 

You will work closely with SRE, DevOps, engineering, and platform teams to leverage Generative AI, machine learning, automation frameworks, and operational data to build practical AI-powered solutions for production environments. This will include developing AI agents, intelligent automation workflows, operational assistants, automated alert triage and correlation, root-cause analysis capabilities, and predictive monitoring solutions. 

 

The role will require a strong understanding of both software engineering and production operations, with a focus on taking AI solutions from concept and experimentation through to reliable, scalable production implementations. Your efforts will help reduce manual operational effort, improve incident response and resolution times, minimize operational risk, and establish a more intelligent, autonomous, and scalable operating model for the platform. 

 

 

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILL SETS 

Education: Bachelor's degree or master's in computer science, Engineering, Software Engineering or a relevant field 

Experience: Relevant 4+ years of experience in SRE, Production Support, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a similar technology role, with hands-on experience in Python-based automation and a strong interest or experience in applying AI/Generative AI to production operations. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Design, develop, and implement AI-powered tooling and automation to improve the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of production operations. 

Identify repetitive, manual, and time-consuming operational activities and develop intelligent solutions to automate or significantly reduce human intervention. 

Build and productionize AI/Generative AI solutions for use cases such as incident triage, alert analysis and correlation, log analysis, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, and operational assistance. 

Develop AI agents, intelligent workflows, and automation frameworks that can assist or execute defined operational activities with appropriate controls and guardrails. 

Work closely with SRE, DevOps, Development, and Engineering teams to understand operational challenges and translate them into scalable AI and automation use cases. 

Integrate AI capabilities with existing SRE and production-support workflows, including monitoring, alerting, incident management, knowledge management platforms. 

Develop solutions that can proactively identify operational anomalies, assist with troubleshooting, recommend remediation actions, and support predictive operations. 

Measure the effectiveness of AI-driven automation through metrics such as reduction in manual effort, MTTR, alert noise, incident resolution time, and operational toil. 

Participate in the support of critical production systems and work with SRE/engineering teams during major incidents when AI-driven analysis or automation can accelerate investigation and resolution. 

Collaborate with stakeholders across time zones and cultures and engage with clients when required to understand operational challenges and demonstrate AI-driven solutions. 

Required Technical Skills 

Strong Python programming and automation development. 

Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, and prompt engineering. 

Knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures. 

Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms. 

Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

Strong understanding of logging, alerting, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. 

Preferred Skills 

Exposure to LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar agent frameworks. 

Machine learning and anomaly-detection experience. 

Knowledge of vector databases and knowledge-retrieval systems. 

Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana or similar tools. 

Soft Skills 

Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset. 

Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and automate them. 

Effective stakeholder communication. 

Passion for innovation and applying AI to real-world operational challenges.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

- Design and implement advanced Generative AI models to solve complex problems.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.

- Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in NLP and AI technologies.

- Develop scalable and efficient AI algorithms to enhance product offerings.

- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge to foster a culture of learning.

Job Description: We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions, with a strong emphasis on Generative AI, NLP, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Time Series Forecasting. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with LangGraph and other Generative AI frameworks to build cutting-edge AI applications.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and deploy AI/ML models with a focus on NLP, Generative AI, RAG, and Time Series Forecasting workflows.
Engineer and refine prompts to optimize performance for large language models (LLMs) and generative AI applications.
Implement and maintain data preprocessing pipelines, including data cleansing, feature engineering, embedding generation, and transformation for time series data.
Develop end-to-end solutions integrating LLMs with VectorDB (e.g., Weaviate, Pinecone, FAISS) for document retrieval, semantic search, and contextual query answering.
Utilize LangGraph and other Generative AI frameworks to build structured workflows for LLM-based applications.
Train and fine-tune machine learning models, including LLMs, to optimize performance for various use cases.
Analyze and interpret complex datasets, including time series data, ensuring scalable and efficient AI model deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML models into existing systems and workflows.
Ensure models are robust, scalable, and adhere to best practices in ethical AI development.
Conduct testing, performance benchmarking, and iterative refinements of AI models and pipelines.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML, NLP, and cloud technologies and recommend integration strategies for emerging tools and techniques.
Create technical documentation and presentations to effectively communicate AI concepts to stakeholders.
Key Skills and Qualifications:
Required Skills:
AI/ML Expertise: Proven experience in developing, fine-tuning, and deploying AI/ML models, focusing on NLP, Generative AI, and Time Series Forecasting.
Prompt Engineering: Proficiency in designing, testing, and optimizing prompts for LLMs.
Data Analysis: Strong ability to process and interpret large and complex datasets, including time series data, for AI model training and validation.
Programming: Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.
NLP Techniques: Understanding of tokenization, embeddings, transformer-based models (e.g., BERT, GPT, LLaMA), and RAG workflows.
Vector Databases: Experience with Weaviate, Pinecone, FAISS, or similar VectorDBs for document retrieval and storage.
LangGraph & GenAI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, HuggingFace Transformers, OpenAI API, and other Generative AI tools.
Cloud Deployment: Familiarity with deploying AI solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Time Series Forecasting: Experience with ARIMA, LSTM, Prophet, and other forecasting techniques.
Model Training & Fine-Tuning: Ability to train and fine-tune machine learning models, including large language models (LLMs), to enhance performance and accuracy.
Problem-Solving & Collaboration: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and teamwork skills to work effectively in a cross-functional environment.
Preferred Skills:
Experience in implementing RAG workflows and integrating generative AI with retrieval-based systems.
Familiarity with ethical AI principles and compliance frameworks.
Knowledge of additional programming languages such as JavaScript or SQL.
Proficiency in MLOps practices for automating AI/ML pipelines and lifecycle management.
Experience in developing AI-driven applications for real-world industry use cases.

Job Title: Generative AI Engineer LLM & RAG

Experience: 6–9 Years
Locations: Pune, Chennai, Bangalore

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Generative AI Engineer with hands-on expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI application development. The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming skills and experience building, integrating, and deploying production-ready Generative AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise use cases.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, and knowledge bases.
Implement document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, semantic search, and retrieval workflows.
Work with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, or Azure AI Search.
Develop AI applications using frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Integrate commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI GPT models, Anthropic Claude, or Llama.
Improve response quality through prompt engineering, retrieval tuning, evaluation, and hallucination reduction.
Develop APIs and backend services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI.
Implement testing, monitoring, security, and performance optimization for AI applications.
Collaborate with data engineering, cloud, product, and business teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.

Mandatory Skills

Strong Python programming and software development fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Practical experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Knowledge of embeddings, vector search, semantic retrieval, and prompt engineering.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent frameworks.
Understanding of LLM evaluation, response quality, and hallucination mitigation.
Experience integrating AI applications with APIs and enterprise data sources.

Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, or Weaviate.
Knowledge of cloud AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI.
Experience with LLM agents, tool calling, and multi-step workflows.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production deployment.
Knowledge of model fine-tuning, observability, and responsible AI practices.

Experience Requirements

6–9 years of overall software development or relevant engineering experience.
Hands-on project experience delivering LLM and RAG-based applications.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates should have practical experience building production-grade Generative AI solutions, particularly RAG applications, rather than only theoretical knowledge of LLMs or prompt engineering.

Role & responsibilities

Handson engineer to build Pythonbased GenAI and AWS Bedrock solutions, contributing to RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and production-ready AI features under senior guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Develop GenAI features and workflows using Python and AWS Bedrock
Implement RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, grounding)
Build single/multi-step agent workflows using LangChain / LangGraph
Integrate LLMs with APIs, tools, and enterprise applications
Write tested, maintainable Python code with CI/CD pipelines
Monitor basic latency, token usage, and cost metrics
Collaborate with architects, seniors, and QA teams

MustHave Skills

Python - Core concepts: OOP, typing, modules, pytest/unittest, fixtures, basic async

AWS Bedrock - Model invocation (Claude/Titan, etc.), Knowledge bases or retrieval integration, basic understanding of guardrails & access controls

Generative AI - Prompting (system, few-shot), RAG types and approaches, Basic evaluation awareness, LangChain / LangGraph , Simple agent flows and routing

DevOps Basics - Git, PRs, CI pipelines, Docker basics, artifacts

Good to Have

Vector DB exposure (OpenSearch, FAISS, Pinecone, etc.), Kubernetes awareness, ML basics (metrics, crossval, leakage awareness), Understand requirements clearly, Good communication and learning mindset & Team-oriented execution.

Note: Apply only if you are available in Bangalore or ready to relocate .

Experience with dotnet full stack and Gen ai is mandatory.
